summary: Ranger Energy Services filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, reporting completion on October 8, 2026 of its previously announced acquisition of STEP Energy Services' U.S. coiled tubing, fluid and nitrogen pumping, and related well services assets under an Asset Purchase Agreement dated August 31, 2026. Aggregate consideration was approximately $27.5 million, comprising $22.5 million cash plus 307,503 Class A shares valued at $5.0 million based on the trailing 30-trading-day VWAP, subject to customary post-closing adjustments. Cash was funded via the Wells Fargo revolving credit facility. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. Watch integration execution, earn-out-free asset deal structure, and delayed financial statement filings due within 71 days.
